ranking_by: Rmax speed on the June 2026 TOP500 list
title: The 5 Fastest Supercomputers on Earth, Ranked (#1 Is Brand New)

scenes.text: Only five computers on Earth are this fast. Number one is brand new.

scenes.label: JUPITER · 1.00 exaflops
scenes.text: Number five: JUPITER, in Germany. Exactly one exaflop, a quintillion calculations every second.

scenes.label: Aurora · 1.01 exaflops
scenes.text: Number four: Aurora, a national laboratory machine in Illinois. About 1.01 exaflops, barely ahead of JUPITER.

scenes.label: Frontier · 1.35 exaflops
scenes.text: Number three: Frontier, in Tennessee. About 1.35 exaflops, and it was once the fastest computer on Earth.

scenes.label: El Capitan · 1.8 exaflops
scenes.text: Number two: El Capitan, in California. About 1.8 exaflops, and it held first place until June 2026.

scenes.label: LineShine · 2.2 exaflops
scenes.text: Number one: China's LineShine. About 2.2 exaflops, and it runs entirely on ordinary processors, not graphics chips.

description:
The five fastest supercomputers on Earth, ranked by speed on the June 2026 TOP500 list.
Number one, China's LineShine, took the crown from America's El Capitan.
Which country do you think holds the top spot next year?
first_comment: Did you expect China at number one? Which tech record should we rank next?
